decisions.statement: The text is composed whole rather than patched onto the bash a terminal already has.
A name that was once an alias is unaliased before that name is defined as a function.
An account gets one launcher named for the alias index that account has.
The launchers are in the order of the alias indexes rather than of the slugs.
Every launcher reloads the whole set before that launcher dispatches.
A comment above a block states the block's purpose.
Nothing here reads a page or the disk.
The `gp` alias reaches akasha on PATH where every launcher reaches the checkout's own.

definition: the whole of the bash a terminal sources, composed as one text
